topic: Movement of Sun, Moon, and Stars
key_concepts: The Sun appears low in the sky early in the morning.
The Sun is high in the sky at noon.
The Sun appears to move upward from morning to noon.
The Sun appears to move downward from noon to late afternoon.
The Full Moon appears low in the sky early in the evening.
The Full Moon is high in the sky at midnight.
The Full Moon appears to move upward from evening to midnight.
The Full Moon appears to move downward from midnight to dawn.
Orion is a group of stars imagined as a hunter.
Orion appears low in the evening sky.
Orion is high in the sky at midnight.
Orion appears to move upward from evening to midnight and downward toward dawn.
